map.CPM（Cost Per Mille/Thousand，千次展示成本）是一种广告: CPM (Cost Per Mille / Thousand) is an ad pricing model in which the advertiser pays per thousand ad impressions. CPM is the core measure of cost efficiency for brand and display advertising.
map.例如：花费2000元广告费，获得50万次展示，则 CPM = (2000 / 5: For example spending 2000 CNY for 500000 impressions gives CPM = (2000 / 500000) × 1000 = 4 CNY per thousand.

map.CPM=CPC×CTR×1000。已知两项可推第三项，便于跨采买方式比价。: CPM = CPC × CTR × 1000. Knowing any two gives the third, which makes pricing comparable across buying methods.
